basis: RNASEH2B-related interferonopathy defined by inflammatory encephalopathy, white-matter injury and intracranial calcification.
Skin and ocular UV injury define XP; supplied HPO reports neurologic degeneration and hypogonadism at 80-99%. Dental and hearing abnormalities omitted at cap.
Angelman neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability and seizures; pigmentation differences do not establish skin or eye damage.
Lentiginosis and cardiac defects define the syndrome; intellectual disability/seizures and sensorineural hearing loss each reported in 1/1 assessed patients; sparse data.
Pathologic ocular neovascularization causes glaucoma and visual loss; diabetes and vascular occlusions are underlying separate diseases.
Named syndrome combines ectodermal appendage abnormalities, congenital joint contractures and diabetes mellitus; supporting clinical detail is limited.
Deletion syndrome includes developmental and intellectual impairment; conductive hearing loss 3/4 and strabismus 6/11 support involvement. Other anomalies have sparse denominators.
Glycosylation disorder with epileptic encephalopathy; skeletal abnormalities 80-99%, scoliosis and ocular defects 30-79%. Frequent liver enzyme elevation omitted at cap.
Developmental impairment and Noonan cardiac malformations define the syndrome; ptosis 6/7 and pes planus 3/7 support additional involvement; cardiac frequencies are uncertain.
Chronic gonococcal infection of the fallopian tubes; reproductive anatomy has no organ axis, but the infectious mechanism applies.
Monocytic leukemic cells infiltrate skin despite absent detectable circulating leukemia; both hematologic lineage and cutaneous location define the disease.
Mature B-cell lymphoma; hepatic infiltration occurs in roughly 30-40%. Common splenic and marrow involvement falls within the hematologic axis.
Syndrome combines cranial suture fusion, joint contractures and an orofacial cleft; skeletal and oral abnormalities are defining features.
Knobloch syndrome is defined by vitreoretinal degeneration and characteristic occipital encephalocele or related neural developmental defects.
Spinal nerve-root disease causes sensory loss and weakness; associated spinal or disc disease is a separate underlying condition.
Manic phase of bipolar disorder is a psychiatric condition without defining damage to an organ axis.
Carcinoma originates in the esophagus; no additional organ involvement is intrinsic to this histologic subtype.
Optic nerve atrophy or hypoplasia and neurodevelopmental impairment define the syndrome; feeding difficulty alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Umbrella disorder of ornithine, proline or hydroxyproline metabolism; no other organ damage is established across the group.
Renal-region liposarcoma arises in adipose tissue surrounding the kidney; no additional organ involvement is established.
Neoplasm occupies the hypothalamus; endocrine dysfunction varies across tumor types and is not established as common for this umbrella concept.
Mycobacterial infection directly damages the kidney; pulmonary tuberculosis is not required and is a separate disease location.
Benign neoplasm located in the stomach; histologic subtype does not establish another organ axis.
Coagulation disorder producing hypercoagulability; vascular thrombosis is a separately diagnosed manifestation or complication, not universal intrinsic vessel damage.
IQCB1-related Senior-Loken syndrome is defined by nephronophthisis with progressive renal failure and retinal rod-cone degeneration.
